title: Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
body:
Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Basher to kya hai unbia ka asara HUSSAIN hai
Main kya baton dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
HUSSAIN fakhr-e-unbia HUSSAIN din ki laaj hai
Har ek dil ko aj bhi HUSSAIN hi ka raj hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yazeed kab ka mit chukka HUSSAIN tha HUSSAIN hai
Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai dil main tere bughz aur zuban peh hai khuda khuda
Dar-e-HUSSAIN chor ke bhatakne wale sun zara
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda us taraf hai jis taraf mera HUSSAIN hai
Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sina ki nok se khuda ne apna zikr jab suna
To us ne tere zikr ko yeh martaba ata kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jahan azaan bhi nahi wahan bhi ya HUSSAIN hai
Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Idher rasool-e-pak hain udher janab-e-sayeda
Hai pusht per hassan to samne ali-e-murtaza
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas in ke darmiyaan hi pala barha HUSSAIN hai
Main kya baton do tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha ek nusaairi shook main najaf se karbala gaya
Jo dekha jalwa noor ka wahan to us ne yeh kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
kasam ali ki aj se mera khuda HUSSAIN hai
Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mile jo per to ro diya khushi se fitr se hazin
kahan paroon se dekh ker who arsh who zameen
<<DIVIDER>>
wohi hai marzi-e-khuda jo chahta HUSSAIN hai
Main kya baton do tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Basher to kya hai unbia ka asara HUSSAIN hai
Main kya bataon dosto tumhein keh kya HUSSAIN hai
author: Mir Hassan Mir
